target: every failure path must emit a parseable status:error envelope; a jq parse failure under set -e aborted before emit_error and left stdout empty
cmd: printf 'OPENROUTER_API_KEY=k\n' > .env; printf 'this is not json' | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openrouter-with-cost.json" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --via openrouter > o.txt 2>/dev/null; echo "EXIT:$?"; if jq -e '.status == "error"' o.txt >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo ERROR_ENVELOPE; else echo NO_ENVELOPE; fi
